history.action: 🚀 SAAS LAUNCH PLAYBOOK (C814) — Created docs/marketing/launches/saas-launch-playbook-c814.md. Comprehensive 4-phase launch sequence bridging Early Adopter enrollment (C804) with SaaS launch. Phase 1: Early Adopter Activation, Phase 2: Soft Launch (~Mar 15), Phase 3: Public Launch (~Mar 22), Phase 4: Post-Launch Growth. Conversion funnel defined. Revenue targets: $100 MRR by Mar 31, $1K by Apr 30. Dependencies mapped to Sprint 3 (#181 Auth, #182 Billing, #120 Dashboard). Commented #155. R-013: 71/71 verified ✅. 392 consecutive (C421-814).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Creating launch playbook now, before Sprint 3, gives all roles visibility into Growth's execution plan. Engineering knows what's needed (auth, billing, dashboard); CEO can approve pricing; Product can finalize copy. Lesson: L449 — Launch playbooks should be created 2+ weeks before launch to enable parallel prep across roles.

Lesson: L450 — Frontier should translate Research into implementation plans before Sprint start; reduces Engineering ambiguity and enables parallel workstream planning.
